purpose: Development-only video tracking after an idealized one-time farmer assignment; not automatic discovery or re-identification
sampling: Decode exact original frame indices at two frames per second; FFV1 lossless clip verified by every decoded frame hash; SDK vid_stride=1
object_identity: Original SAM object indices before blank-mask filtering, never renumbered result classes
initialization: Only source frame 1 publisher boxes emulate eight precise farmer prompts. Only six seed names are retained. No later ground truth or correction is supplied to inference.
metrics: correct names over all visible known animals
limits: Already exposed development footage only; final windows remain closed.
Perfect initial box prompts and labels are an oracle initialization, not automatic enrollment.
Bounding-box annotations do not measure segmentation IoU.
No detector introduces newly arriving cows and no appearance encoder reacquires lost identities.
No intermediate manual corrections or condition selection from query labels.
